 Is Chick-fil-A Offering a Free Veterans Day Meal?
 The answer is: Maybe.

 As Veterans Day gets closer, active-duty service members and veterans are probably searching to find out if their favorite restaurants are offering a freebie or discount. And if Chick-fil-A is on your list of favorites, you might find conflicting answers to the question: Does Chick-fil-A have a Veterans Day deal?
 The answer is: Maybe.
 According to the Chick-fil-A website , this is because Chick-fil-A doesn’t offer a chain-wide military deal. Every restaurant is operated by local franchise owners and they all individually make the decision whether or not to extend an offer. This means that some restaurants will offer a military deal, and if they do, those deals will vary by location.
 Your local Chick-fil-A may offer up a free meal all day long on November 11. Your friend’s Chick-fil-A in another state may offer a 10% military discount off a total purchase. Your brother’s Chick-fil-A may organize a military appreciation event to celebrate local service members. And you might see on social media a random Chick-fil-A that’s offering a free Chicken Biscuit only in the morning, another that offers a year-round discount that doesn’t change on Veterans Day, and another that offers nothing at all.
 A customer places an order at the counter of a Chick-fil-A restaurant Monday, Oct. 7, 2024, in southeast Denver. (AP Photo/David Zalubowski) 
 All of these can be true.
 So what should you do?
 Check your location’s policy before your mouth starts watering for a free sandwich. But don’t worry, it’s easy.
 Either in the app or on the Chick-fil-A website , find your preferred location’s phone number and give them a call. Make sure to ask if they are offering a Veterans Day deal and, if so, what the deal is, the dates you can redeem it, who is eligible, and what ID is required (such as a valid military ID, veteran-designated driver's license, VA card, or DD-214).
 (These are actually perfect questions to ask any restaurant you’re hoping to visit on Veterans Day. And if you’re planning to bring your family, make sure to ask if the deal includes military dependents.)
 What happens if your closest Chick-fil-A isn’t offering a Veterans Day deal? Try another one nearby!
 Most Chick-fil-A restaurants will be open regular hours on Veterans Day, but it can’t hurt to add operating hours to your list of questions to ask. And like most restaurants offering specials on Nov. 11, be prepared for big crowds and pack your patience.
